description: Implementation of disk cache file operations for Windows, including asynchronous IO handling, file initialization, read/write, and length management.

classes.name: MyOverlapped
classes.description: Structure for managing overlapped IO operations, holding context, file reference, callback, and completion handler.

classes.name: CompletionHandler
classes.description: Handles IO completion notifications for overlapped IO, manages callback invocation and reference counting.

methods.name: File::Init
methods.description: Initializes the file object, opens Windows file handles with overlapped IO, and registers IO handler.

methods.name: File::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the file object has valid underlying file handles.

methods.name: File::Read
methods.description: Performs synchronous read from the file at a specified offset.

methods.name: File::Write
methods.description: Performs synchronous write to the file at a specified offset.

methods.name: File::Read (overload)
methods.description: Performs asynchronous read with callback, managing overlapped IO.

methods.name: File::Write (overload)
methods.description: Performs asynchronous write with callback, managing overlapped IO.

methods.name: File::SetLength
methods.description: Sets the length of the file.

methods.name: File::GetLength
methods.description: Retrieves the current length of the file.

methods.name: File::AsyncWrite
methods.description: Helper for performing asynchronous write operations.

methods.name: File::platform_file
methods.description: Returns the underlying platform file handle.

methods.name: File::WaitForPendingIOForTesting
methods.description: Static method to wait for pending IO operations to complete during testing.

methods.name: File::DropPendingIO
methods.description: Static method placeholder for dropping pending IO operations.
